data.title: SDLG Group Holds Global Brand Launch Event in Shanghai
data.description:
SDLG Group Holds Global Brand Launch Event in Shanghai

SDLG Group Holds Global Brand Launch Event in Shanghai

PR Newswire

SHANGHAI, Nov. 26, 2026

Group unveils its new global brand strategy under the theme "United for a Century Legacy"

SHANGHAI, Nov. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SDLG Group today unveiled its new global brand strategy, "ONE SDLG," alongside a unified brand architecture and a new visual identity ahead of bauma CHINA 2026. The launch marks a strategic shift from business coordination to a shared vision across the group's operations.

Competition in the global construction equipment industry now extends across the entire value chain. Building on more than 50 years of manufacturing experience, SDLG Group is bringing its businesses together under a unified brand strategy. Looking ahead, the Group has set an RMB 100 billion target for 2030. The group plans to expand its global manufacturing network and accelerate the development of new energy equipment and intelligent machines.

Wang Zhizhong, Honorary Chairman of SDLG Group and Chairman of SDLG, highlighted the group's long-standing commitment to "Forge a Renowned Brand, Build a Century Legacy." Guided by its core brand promise of "Reliability in Action," SDLG Group has grown into one of China's leading construction equipment manufacturers and a globally competitive comprehensive equipment manufacturing group.

Customers from Brazil and China shared their experiences with SDLG's equipment and service support, demonstrating how these principles translate into practice.

Fernando Fagundes, Executive Director of the Board at Brazil's Fagundes Construção e Mineração, highlighted the partnership established at bauma 2025 in Munich. Following field trials, the company placed volume orders for LGMG's CMT106H mining trucks and RTH100 hybrid mining trucks. More than 100 LGMG hybrid mining trucks are now operating at Brazilian mines, with a payload capacity of up to 90 metric tons per truck and overall fuel savings of more than 30%. Fernando Fagundes also praised LGMG's local service capabilities and round-the-clock support.

Li Shengjie, Deputy General Manager of Xinfa Group, reflected on nearly 20 years of cooperation with SDLG. The partnership began with comparative field tests of equipment from several manufacturers during Xinfa's facility expansion. Today, more than 500 SDLG machines support Xinfa's core operations. Mr. Li attributed the long-standing partnership to equipment reliability and full-lifecycle service.

Wang Xin, Rotating Chairman and Executive Chairman of SDLG Group, outlined how the new brand strategy extends reliability beyond product performance to research and development, manufacturing, marketing and service. She identified three priorities: ensuring consistent product quality, delivering customer value throughout the equipment lifecycle and building a collaborative ecosystem centered on green and intelligent technologies and deeper local operations.

With the new logo unveiled, SDLG presents a unified identity as "ONE SDLG," embarking on a new 50-year journey of high-quality growth.

In the future, SDLG Group will continue to drive its growth through product excellence, intelligent innovation, full-lifecycle support and industry-wide collaboration. The group will continue to develop high-end equipment and advance new energy and intelligent technologies, staying true to its core brand promise of "Reliability in Action." Together with its global partners, SDLG Group aims to build a world-class construction equipment brand.

data.title: PRIME BPM Unveils AI Agents 2.0 to Accelerate Business Process Management and Transformation
data.description:
PRIME BPM Unveils AI Agents 2.0 to Accelerate Business Process Management and Transformation

Enhanced AI capabilities deliver 90%+ process map quality, multilingual support, and faster documentation, with conversational mapping and advanced analysis on the horizon.

PRIME BPM, a leading provider of end-to-end AI-powered Business Process Management software, has announced AI Agents 2.0, the next evolution of its four AI agents launched in January 2026. Building on strong adoption across industries, the latest advancements enhance AI-powered process mapping and documentation to help organizations accelerate BPM and operational excellence initiatives.

The enhancements improve AI-generated process quality, reduce manual effort, and make BPM activities more intuitive and accessible.

Key enhancements delivered include:

  • 90%+ process map quality: Improved MapAI capabilities deliver higher-quality BPMN process maps, with support for external lanes and message events.
  • Multilingual and voice-powered mapping: Users can describe processes through voice input and generate maps in 30+ languages, including languages different from the source content.
  • Enhanced Image-to-Map: MapAI captures 100% of identified process content from source images and PDFs, reducing manual corrections.
  • Faster, context-aware SOP generation: AI Procedure Writer combines on-screen context with voice input to generate more relevant procedures.

The added capabilities build on real-world adoption of PRIME BPM's AI agents. A leading bank mapped nearly 4,000 processes in under a month, while a leading aerospace manufacturing organization reported an estimated 70% reduction in mapping time by converting Post-it notes into structured process maps.

Expanding Conversational and Cross-Process Analysis Capabilities

PRIME BPM is developing capabilities that will allow users to build and refine process maps through natural-language conversations and generate supporting procedures alongside process maps.

Planned enhancements to its Digital Process Analyst include richer process analysis using procedures, task attributes, and other process information, alongside library-level analysis to identify improvement opportunities across multiple processes.

"AI is fundamentally changing how organizations approach BPM," said Mark Khabe, Co-Founder of PRIME BPM. "With these advancements, we're making it faster and easier for teams to discover, map, document, and analyze processes using AI, reducing manual effort and accelerating meaningful improvement and transformation outcomes."

PRIME BPM continues to advance its AI capabilities to make business process management faster, more accessible, and scalable across organizations.

About PRIME BPM

PRIME BPM is a cloud-based, AI-powered Business Process Management platform that helps organizations map, analyze, improve, and monitor business processes. Combining BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, and AI technologies, PRIME BPM helps organizations accelerate operational excellence and business transformation initiatives.

Website – https://www.primebpm.com
Email - info@primebpm.com

data.title: We are living in perilous times if Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dictates your 401(k) balance
data.description:
By Quentin Fottrell

Why did a futurist with Huang's prescient vision build a company where all roads lead to him?

The turmoil in markets is a cautionary tale of putting so much power in the hands of one man.

Jensen Huang said he'd do better this time. Not everyone is resting easily.

He helped fuel the global AI revolution from the helm of one of the world's most powerful companies. When he became embroiled in a national-security scandal, the fallout led to a couple of trillion dollars in paper losses, give or take a billion. Before his resignation more than two weeks ago, Huang acknowledged that he had an affair with a woman who has been accused of being a Chinese spy; since then, there were reports of two more affairs with female Nvidia employees.

A Moneyist reader asks if any readers are as vulnerable to Nvidia's fortunes as the global economy appears to be. "Did Nvidia's (NVDA) turmoil put your wealth at risk?" the reader asks. "Whose future wealth depends on one man's personal life? I know some people will be deliberately extra when they respond - of course, my whole portfolio didn't tank. Like most people, I'm diversified. But isn't it interesting how our 401(k)s can be affected by one guy in a black leather jacket?"

A 401(k) with 60% to 80% equity exposure lost roughly 5.5% to 7.5% of its on-paper value.

Even before a cloud of uncertainty enveloped Nvidia, the broader AI market and - eventually - the entire stock market, the average retirement balance had fallen in value in the third quarter of the year. The average 401(k) balance in the quarter fell 2% to $152,500, according to an analysis by Fidelity Investments released Monday. IRA balances dropped by 1% to $142,261, while the average 403(b) balance fell by 2% to $142,100.

Based on the S&P 500's SPX 9.3% decline between Nov. 11 and Nov. 20, a typical 401(k) with 60% to 80% equity exposure lost roughly 5.5% to 7.5% of its on-paper value. On an average $152,500 balance, as reported by Fidelity, that translates to $8,500 to $11,350 - or $600 billion to $800 billion across all 401(k) plans. With markets rallying on Monday on the news of Huang's return, 401(k), IRA and 403(b) accounts recovered a portion of those paper losses, though the durability of that rebound is no sure thing.

The turmoil in markets is a cautionary tale of putting so much power in the hands of one man. Huang returned to his role after President Donald Trump implored Nvidia's board of directors to reinstate their former CEO. The board ultimately complied to restore stability to the share price, despite lingering concerns about Huang's governance. Even so, Huang, who presides over a reported 60 direct reports, had not mentored any clear heir apparent.

Related: I hate that Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, but I love what it's done for my 401(k). Am I a hypocrite?

All roads lead to Huang

The stock bounced back, at least when his return was initially announced, in part because Trump believes Nvidia and Huang go together like salt and pepper and are key to the continuing AI boom and the health of the U.S. economy. He has reason to feel this way: The Brookings Institution estimates that investment in data-center buildings, power systems, networking infrastructure, microchips and other equipment will hit $10.3 trillion from 2025 to 2032, or roughly 3.63% of gross domestic product per year.

Members of the Moneyist Facebook (META) Group painted a grim picture of this moment. This reader is unsettled by the concentration of market power: "Since the advent of the atom bomb, all futures have been at risk from the whims of one man." And try this on for size: "Anyone who invests in the market is at the whim of the billionaires. Elon Musk tweets and things go berserk." And lastly: "It's always been a risk. Potentially 100 million Americans are invested in Nvidia through mutual funds and retirement accounts."

President Trump believes that Nvidia and Huang go together like salt and pepper.

Huang is instrumental to Nvidia's success and built it into an AI behemoth. In a few short years, he has become a globally recognized tech leader in the iconic style of the late Steve Jobs - even down to the silhouette. Jobs wore his signature black turtleneck and Huang sports a dashing black leather jacket, although he chose a softer, warmer material when he made his triumphant return to Nvidia's HQ in Santa Clara (reportedly a navy cotton Dior shirt).

And yet a futurist with Huang's prescient vision still built a company where all roads lead to him. As tech analyst Daniel Bader noted on CTV News, this is the same man who lied about the affair to his employees, his board of directors, and the general public. "I think that Jensen Huang is the only person who can lead the current version of Nvidia," Bader said, "and I think that coming to terms with that fact was very difficult for both the broader market and internally."

I'm willing to guess that CEOs who neglect to groom successors and perhaps compartmentalize their strategies, supply-chain command and dealmaking do not do so accidentally, but to maintain a tight grip on the corporate helm because their identity is inextricably tied to their role - and the power it brings them. And so here we are. Ultimately, shareholders believed that Nvidia's mission and that of the many tech companies tied to the growth of AI were at risk absent Huang's leadership.

His greatest feat may be making himself irreplaceable - or at least making us all believe that he is.

Related: Is Social Security a Ponzi scheme? No. Don't get carried away with 1930s-era prophecies of doom.

By emailing your questions to The Moneyist or posting your dilemmas on The Moneyist Facebook group, you agree to have them published anonymously on MarketWatch.

By submitting your story to Dow Jones & Co., the publisher of MarketWatch, you understand and agree that we may use your story, or versions of it, in all media and platforms, including via third parties.

More columns from Quentin Fottrell:

'I've been a stay-at-home mom': I'm 50 and have a chronic illness. My husband lost his job. Should he raid his 401(k)?

I'm terrified of a market crash. Should I put $400,000 of my $1 million retirement savings into an annuity?

We have a $300,000 mortgage with a 2.75% interest rate. I want to pay it off. My husband says I'm crazy. Who's right?

-Quentin Fottrell

data.title: Kiwi Ears Marcato: A Compact Form with a Distinctive Voice
data.description:
NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / Designed with comfort and practicality in mind, the Kiwi Ears Marcato features a compact teardrop-shaped shell that fits naturally and securely in the ear. Its ergonomic design provides a comfortable fit and effective noise isolation, making it suitable for long listening sessions, stage performances, and daily use. The housing is constructed from zinc alloy, offering a combination of durability and a lightweight feel. Finished with a satin surface, the Marcato maintains a clean, understated appearance that complements its functional design.

Vocal-Focused Tuning
The Marcato is tuned with a particular focus on vocal reproduction. Its bass response delivers deep sub-bass impact that transitions smoothly into a lush low-midrange, enhancing the weight and presence of bass guitar while bringing greater body and warmth to vocals. The treble features a carefully tuned peak at 3kHz to improve vocal clarity and align with the ear's natural sound perception. This tuning makes the Marcato a suitable monitoring tool for musicians and vocalists on stage, while also complementing genres such as pop, rock, and hip-hop.

Detachable 2-Pin 0.78mm Cable
The Marcato comes equipped with a lightweight and versatile custom cable, featuring 32 AWG and 26 AWG wires arranged in 14-strand and 10-strand configurations, respectively. Its detachable 0.78mm 2-pin connector allows the cable to be easily replaced or upgraded without changing the earphones themselves. This flexibility gives users more freedom to customize their listening and wearing experience while helping extend the lifespan of the earphones.

Driver: 10 mm Dynamic Driver
Diaphragm: PET
Frequency Response: 20 Hz - 40 kHz
Impedance: 18 Ω @ 1 kHz

THD: ≤ 0.5% @ 1 kHz

Kiwi Ears is a leading audio brand dedicated to crafting innovative, high-quality audio solutions for audiophiles, music enthusiasts, and professionals. From IEMs to headphones, Kiwi Ears combines cutting-edge technology with a passion for sound to create products that inspire and delight.

data.title: North Shore Closes Flow-Through Share Private Placement
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / North Shore Uranium Ltd. (TSXV:NSU)(OTCQB:NSURF) ("North Shore" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has closed its non-brokered private placement offering previously announced on November 18, 2026 (the "Offering") for gross proceeds of $1,110,930 through the issuance of 5,847,000 flow-through common shares of the Company (each, a "FT Share"). The Offering was upsized from the previously announced maximum of $1,100,000.

Each FT Share was issued at a price of $0.19 per FT Share. Each FT Share was issued as a "flow-through share" within the meaning of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the "ITA").

The Company intends to use the gross proceeds of the Offering to incur "Canadian exploration expenses" that qualify as "flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures" (as such terms are defined in the ITA) on the Company's uranium properties in Saskatchewan, which will be renounced to the subscribers of FT Shares with an effective date no later than December 31, 2026. The costs of the Offering will be paid from the Company's general working capital.

In connection with the Offering, the Company paid cash finder's fees of $66,655.80 and issued 350,820 non-transferable finder's warrants to certain arm's length finders. Each non-transferable finder's warrant is exercisable to acquire one common share of the Company at a price of $0.19 per share for a period of two years from the date of closing the Offering, subject to compliance with the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange (the "Exchange") and applicable securities laws.

All securities issued in connection with the Offering are subject to a statutory hold period expiring March 27, 2027.

The Offering remains subject to final acceptance of the Exchange.

The securities referred to in this news release have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "U.S. Securities Act"), or any state securities laws and may not be offered or sold within the United States or to, or for the account or benefit of, U.S. persons absent registration under the U.S. Securities Act and applicable state securities laws, unless an exemption from such registration is available. "United States" and "U.S. person" have the respective meanings assigned in Regulation S under the U.S. Securities Act.

The nuclear power industry is undergoing increased development to meet CO₂ emission-reduction goals and the needs of new power-intensive technologies like AI. North Shore is focused on advancing exploration for uranium deposits at Rio Puerco in the Grants Uranium District of New Mexico and its Falcon and West Bear properties at the eastern margin of the Athabasca Basin in Saskatchewan. data.title: WeFetch AI Corp. Hits 30M in Monthly AI Agent Traffic
data.description:
WeFetch AI Corp. Hits 30M in Monthly AI Agent Traffic

WeFetch AI Corp. Hits 30M in Monthly AI Agent Traffic

PR Newswire

VANCOUVER, BC and LONDON, Nov. 26, 2026

gtinfetch.ai: 12 artificial intelligence (AI) agent calls a second, 700 a minute and one million a day, on 84.8 million barcodes.

VANCOUVER, BC and LONDON, Nov. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WeFetch AI Corp. today reported 30 million in AI agent traffic over the prior 30 days across its products. Shoppers now use AI, and gtinfetch.ai delivers the barcode for the AI agents of consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers. gtinfetch.ai, the Company's lead product, holds 84,810,515 barcodes, known as Global Trade Item Numbers (GTINs), and eliminates the guesswork.

Key facts

  • Company: WeFetch AI Corp.
  • Lead product: gtinfetch.ai, the AI agentic shopping barcode engine.
  • AI agent traffic: 30 million over the prior 30 days.
  • Barcodes: 84,810,515 Global Trade Item Numbers (GTINs).
  • Ways to buy: enterprise licence, or PayGo on x402.
  • PayGo currencies: USDC and Open USD.
  • Access: Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Training nodes: gtinfinder.ai, barcode pages by market, powered by gtinfetch.ai.
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure in France, Singapore and the United States, with redundancies on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

The market: McKinsey projects that AI agents will orchestrate $3 trillion to $5 trillion in global commerce by 2030, up to $1 trillion of it in US retail. Every AI agent purchase needs the right barcode.

Two Ways to Buy gtinfetch.ai

An AI agent that shops needs the barcode, not a description of the product. gtinfetch.ai is the agentic software that delivers it: the right barcode, verified, to the AI agent that asks. gtinfetch.ai removes the guesswork and connects consumers shopping with AI to the brands. Access is now sold two ways.

  • Enterprise licence. A business licenses the 84 million gtinfetch.ai barcodes to design and run its own AI agents. The enterprise licence is for brands, retailers and the companies that build AI agents for them.
  • PayGo on x402. An AI agent pays gtinfetch.ai per call, inside the call, with no account, no seat and no licence. PayGo on x402 accepts two currencies: USDC and Open USD.

The enterprise licence and PayGo on x402 run on the same software and the same 84 million barcodes. gtinfetch.ai holds the barcodes in full on Microsoft Azure in France, Singapore and the United States, with redundancies on Amazon Web Services (AWS). gtinfetch.ai is live on Model Context Protocol (MCP) at mcp.gtinfetch.ai/mcp.

The Fastest Shift in FMCG and Retail on Record

In 2024, shopping with AI was a curiosity: a few hundred million people used AI at all. In the fourth quarter of 2026, three billion people use AI, and more than half of consumers shop with AI. The change took 24 months and reached fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) and retail first.

  • People. Generative AI tools have 3.24 billion active users, 38.9% of the world's population. (Source: Digital 2027, We Are Social and Meltwater, October 2026.)
  • Shoppers. 53% of consumers across 11 markets shop with AI. (Source: McKinsey, October 2026.)
  • Traffic. AI traffic to US retail sites is up 1,772% since Adobe began tracking it in October 2024. (Source: Adobe, October 2026.)

FMCG and Retail Now Run AI Agents. Their Product Data Is Not Ready.

Shoppers moved to AI first. Brands and retailers are now building AI agents to meet AI shoppers, on product data that was never made for AI agents.

  • 41% of US consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies are already developing agentic AI capabilities. (Source: BCG, GenAI CPG Survey 2026, October 2026.)
  • 18% of retailers judge their marketplaces ready for AI agents. BCG blames fragmented legacy systems and poorly structured product data. (Source: BCG, October 2026.)
  • McKinsey advises retailers to fix product, price and stock data, or lose visibility as AI shopping grows. (Source: McKinsey, October 2026.)

The same product carries a different description in every system. An AI agent that matches on words can pick the wrong size, the wrong pack or the wrong maker. The barcode is the one identifier that the brand, the retailer and the AI agent already share.

"We built gtinfetch.ai as the AI agentic shopping barcode engine, the largest AI-agent-native source of verified barcodes, for every consumer AI agent that buys," said Matthew Keddy, Chief Executive Officer of WeFetch AI Corp. "A shopper's AI query starts as text, and it turns into a sale more reliably when the answer is anchored to a barcode. With 84 million barcodes and 30 million in monthly AI agent traffic, we connect our customers to the sale."

data.title: Panther Minerals Adopts Semi-Annual Reporting
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / Panther Minerals Inc. ("Panther" or the "Company") (CSE:PURR)(OTCQB:GLIOF)(FWB:2BC) announces that it has elected to rely on Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933 - Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers (the "Order") and move to semi-annual financial reporting ("SAR"). This news release is being filed pursuant to Coordinated Blanket Order 51 - 933 Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers.

The Order allows eligible venture issuers listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "CSE") to voluntarily move from a quarterly to a semi-annual financial reporting framework. The Company's fiscal year ends on June 30. Under the SAR pilot program, the Company will be exempt from filing interim financial reports and related Management's Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) for its first and third quarters.

  • Interim Period: The Company will not file an interim report for the first quarter (Q1) ending September 30 and the third quarter (Q3) ending March 31; and
  • Ongoing Reporting: The Company will continue to file audited financial statements (due within 120 days of June 30) and six-month interim financial reports (due within 60 days of December 31).

The Company confirms it meets the pilot program's eligibility criteria, which include being a venture issuer with annual revenues of no more than $10 million, having been a reporting issuer in at least one Canadian jurisdiction for at least 12 months and having ﬁled all required periodic and timely continuous disclosure documents.

The ﬁrst period for which the Company will not ﬁle an interim ﬁnancial report and related MD&A will be for the three-month period ended September 30, 2026.

About Panther Minerals Inc.

Panther Minerals Inc. is a North American critical minerals exploration company. Its portfolio includes the Rubidium Ridge lithium-cesium-tantalum property near Atikokan, Ontario, the East Brouillan property in Quebec, and an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Mesa Top uranium property in New Mexico. Panther trades on the CSE under the symbol PURR, on the OTCQB under the symbol GLIOF and on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the symbol 2BC.

data.title: LUNR Aerospace Appoints Draganfly CEO Cameron Chell to Board of Directors
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / LUNR Aerospace Corp. (CSE:FLY)(Frankfurt:6GB)(WKN:A4269V) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Cameron Chell to its Board of Directors (the "Board"). Mr. Chell is the President, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ:DPRO), a developer of drone systems and autonomous technologies. With more than 30 years of entrepreneurial and executive experience, Mr. Chell brings an extensive background in establishing, financing and growing technology companies across aerospace, defence, autonomous systems, advanced manufacturing and public markets.1

Mr. Chell has founded and co-founded numerous technology ventures, including Engyro, an enterprise software company whose technology was acquired by Microsoft Corporation in 2007.2 He also founded FutureLink, an early developer and operator of data centres for the provision of internet-based software applications including the first to deploy enterprise level applications as the precursor to modern cloud computing services.

His experience in the aerospace sector includes co-founding UrtheCast Corp., a Canadian Earth-observation technology company that developed and deployed high-definition imaging systems on the outside of the International Space Station ("ISS"). In 2015, UrtheCast released what it described as the world's first full-colour HD videos of Earth captured from the ISS.3 The company subsequently ranked first in Deloitte's 2016 Technology Fast 50 program, recognizing it as Canada's fastest-growing technology company based on revenue growth between 2012 and 2015.4

In his current leadership roles at Draganfly, Mr. Chell oversees the publicly traded company developing unmanned aircraft systems and related technologies for commercial, public safety and defence applications. In September 2026, Draganfly announced that it had been awarded a five-year contract by the Government of Canada to supply tactical intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance drone systems to the Canadian Armed Forces.5

Mr. Chell's broader business experience also includes serving as co-founder and chairman of KODAKOne, a digital image rights management platform developed in conjunction with the Eastman Kodak Company.6 His entrepreneurial career has attracted international media attention, including Forbes7 plus television appearances involving CNN8, Fox Business9 and the RedChip Money Report on Bloomberg Television10. He has also been a featured speaker at events at the United Nations, TEDx Montréal Women, and has opened for Tony Robbins on multiple occasions sharing perspectives on entrepreneurship, technology and leadership.11

"I am pleased to join LUNR Aerospace's Board of Directors at an important stage in the Company's development. With the growing importance of sovereign space access for national security, defence and commercial applications, I believe LUNR is pursuing a significant opportunity, but more importantly, a critical mission to help establish Canadian orbital launch capabilities and address the increasing global demand for secure, reliable and cost-effective access to space. I look forward to working with the entire LUNR team to advance the Company's strategic objectives in support of Canada's critical space requirements," said Cameron Chell.

"Cameron brings extensive experience in building and leading technology businesses across aerospace, defence and autonomous systems. His proven background in commercializing emerging technologies, developing strategic relationships and navigating public markets will be a valuable asset to LUNR as we advance our propulsion technologies and orbital launch capabilities. We look forward to leveraging his experience and perspective as we execute our long-term growth strategy," stated Jeanue Chung, CEO of LUNR Aerospace Corp.

About LUNR Aerospace Corp.

LUNR Aerospace Corp. is a Canadian-based company developing orbital launch capability in Canada to support sovereign access to space and serve the global launch market. The Company is focused on advancing Canadian launch infrastructure designed to help address constrained global launch capacity and enable future payload launches from Canadian soil. LUNR's planned launch systems are being designed for low-Earth orbit, polar, and sun-synchronous missions, with an emphasis on scalable vehicle architecture, reusability, and cost-efficient deployment.
